verdict.rationale: Founder Law says it handles employer-side work, including "H-1B, L-1, and employment-based visas to hire and retain global teams." It also has a corporate immigration practice covering employee H-1B extensions and amendments, helps employers with H-1B transfers and the lottery, and offers flat-fee packages for H-1B, L-1, E-3 and TN petitions. That makes it plausible to run a team's visas through this one provider. However, nothing shows multi-case management tooling, team or volume pricing, or a defined scale-up employer program; the Techstars material is only a self-serve resource library and a discount code for founders. missing for 10: multi-case or portfolio management for employers, team or volume pricing or a dedicated startup/scale-up employer program, independent or hands-on corroboration of handling team-wide sponsorship.
